messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm opening a docs PR with small offline healthcheck scripts for Private/VPC installs (post-install connectivity checks + kube-proxy sanity). Need a quick review on the kube-proxy/iptables ordering bits before I merge: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/1234

maria: Draft snippet I'm adding to the quickstart (very small):
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# simple connectivity check for onprem nodes
set -e
MASTER_IP=10.0.0.1
PORT=8443
timeout 3 bash -c "</dev/tcp/$MASTER_IP/$PORT" || { echo 'control plane unreachable'; exit 2; }
echo 'control plane reachable'
```

kevin: @maria looks good. i'd prefer nc -zv for clearer exit codes on most distros: `nc -zv $MASTER_IP $PORT` :eyes:

kevin: also, can we add a fallback to curl for environments that block raw TCP (corporate proxies)? small snippet: `curl --connect-timeout 3 -sS https://$MASTER_IP:$PORT/healthz || nc -zv ...`

sasha: FYI on kube-proxy: some older kernels/rtu setups need conntrack max and iptables FORWARD ordering noted. we should call out: add the iptables prerouting FORWARD rules BEFORE the user iptables rules in the installer examples.

sasha: quick suggested doc text: "If using nftables or custom iptables rules, ensure the kube-proxy rule chain is inserted before any DROP/REJECT policies. On kernels with conntrack disabled, the healthcheck must rely on TCP connect rather than conntrack lookups."

anil: security note: do NOT print KMS key material or HSM socket paths in CI logs. if the script probes PKCS#11 modules, ensure logs mask `PKCS11_MODULE_PATH` and any PEM contents. add a short paragraph in the doc incl. example: `echo '***masked***'` when showing output.

maria: good catches. i'll update the PR with: nc fallback, curl fallback, and a short security paragraph. who owns the systemd unit fragments for the onprem installer? need to mention CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE and Restart=on-failure defaults.

kevin: i can grab the systemd bit. i'll add a note and a tiny test in the docs CI that runs the healthcheck container (offline image) on the runner. i'll push a follow-up commit to the PR later today :thumbsup:

pr-bot: PR opened by maria/docs: "offline healthcheck scripts and kube-proxy notes" — CI: pending checks (docs-lint, linkcheck) https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/1234 :robot_face:

maria: thanks all — i'll incorporate kevin/sasha/anil comments and mark for review. planning to merge after linkcheck passes and kevin's systemd note lands. :shipit:
